note: Copy to settings.json (setup.ps1 does it). Without settings.json CS2 is found through Steam and addon is mcp_lab. addon: the only CS2 addon this tool writes to. compile_threads 0 = all cores. blender: path to blender.exe ("" = search tools/, Steam libraries, Program Files). backups_dir: map copies and sources snapshots ("" = <project>/backups; best on another disk or in a synced folder such as OneDrive, e.g. "D:\\Backups\\cs2map"). backup_sources: more folders to snapshot besides my/ and the addon content. restart_hung_cs2: true lets the MCP restart CS2 Workshop Tools it launched itself (game_launch) when it stays "Not responding" for restart_hung_cs2_seconds (>= 60): kill, relaunch with this addon, reload the map, retry the call once. restart_hung_cs2_user: true also restarts a Workshop Tools session of this addon that the user started (for unattended sessions; refused while Hammer has unsaved edits); a plain game is never touched (setup.ps1 asks once). marks_key: the CS2 key testers press to mark a spot for the AI ("" = off). game_focus: when the CS2 window may take the focus from what you are doing: never (frames, map loads and tests run behind your windows; a real mouse step is emulated, a HUD click is refused), input_only (default: the window comes to the front only for a step with real mouse input and gives the focus back at once), always (in front for every frame and test, as before 1.4). build_priority: low (default) starts compiler and Blender jobs below normal priority so the PC stays responsive during a build; normal = as any program. heavy_builds: allow (default) lets the AI start light bakes and releases; ask refuses them with their time and memory until you allow each in the panel. panel: true starts the status page with the MCP server (http://127.0.0.1:<panel_port>/, this PC only): what the tools do now, frames, the load of the PC, switches for these permissions; python tools/panel.py starts it by hand. limits: disk caps (player marks: marks_days, marks_max, marks_mb; oldest go first); files named in README/docs/reports are never removed; map copies follow tiers (keep_last copies, hourly hours, daily days, weekly weeks) and caps in MB of compressed copies.
